FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF APPLIED MANAGEMENT SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014.
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF FIELD INVESTIGATORS
Project: Socio-Psychological Impacts of Drug Addiction on the Wives of the Addicts: A
Study of Doaba Region in Punjab
Sponsoring Agency: National Commission for Women, New Delhi
Designation: Field Investigator (03)
Requirements for Field Investigator: Applicants are required to have completed
Graduation with minimum 50% marks. Preference will be given to the candidates having
experience in data collection, data entry, data analysis, report writing, etc. Candidate must be
well versed with the research methodology.
Honorarium: Field Investigator is entitled to Rs. 15,000/ per month (Fixed).
Duration: The duration shall be of 4 months or may be terminated even before (with one
week notice if the work is not found satisfactory).
Domain for Data Collection: Punjab (Jalandhar, Kapurthala, Nawashahar)
How to apply
Applications on plain paper giving following details must reach the undersigned by May
6, 2023.
Full Bio-data including name, parents name, postal address, email and mobile number along
with academic details starting from 10th onwards and experience as well as supporting
documents.
Application as a single PDF file can also be sent by email to monikaa@pu.ac.in
Hard copy can be brought at the time of interview, incase application is sent through email.
(Monika Aggarwal)
Professor and Principal Investigator of the Project
University Institute of Applied Management Sciences
